01 How much experience Reaching level 60 takes 4,084,700 experience: 499,000 to 30 and 2,306,100 to 50. 02 Rested XP Rested XP doubles experience from enemies and does not affect quests. In an inn or capital it builds 5% of a level per 8 hours, capped at 150% (about 10 days offline). 03 Food and bedroll Most cooked food gives +5% experience from enemies for about 15 minutes. The Cozy Sleeping Bag gives up to 3% and stays after death, and lying on it builds rest even while offline. 04 Quests at your level Quests 5 or more levels below you lose 10–20% experience per extra level, grey enemies give no experience. 05 Riding From level 40: training 100 gold and a mount 20 (+60% speed). At 60: 1,000 and 200 gold (+100%). Honored with your faction gives 10% off. Paladins and Warlocks get their mount through class quests. Tip Log out in an inn, a capital or on the bedroll: the next evening starts with double experience from enemies. Food, the bedroll and rest stack.

Solo Duo Group Quests are the core of leveling: their experience does not depend on a group. Rest only works on enemies, so start the evening with kills while you have it. Tip Hunters and Warlocks have the easiest time solo, their pet holds the enemy. Each player gets full experience for a quest turn-in, while experience from enemies is shared. Keep your levels close: in Forever a higher-level group member gets a bigger experience penalty, and Blizzard made boosting a friend unprofitable. Tip Pick up quests together and turn them in at the same time. If one of you gets ahead, let the other catch up solo. The bigger the group, the less experience each member gets per enemy, while quests still give full experience. A big group pays off in dungeons and on elite quests, and between them you can split into pairs. Dungeons and raids Which dungeon fits your level and who to bring

Progress for the whole Battle.net account. Points are earned from challenges and spent on perks separately on each character. 01 First point The system unlocks with the first point: level 25 on a character, or 150 in a profession (not gathering), or exploring the whole map. 02 Challenges Each challenge gives 1 point. According to Blizzard there are 65 challenges in six categories: classes 27, professions 18, PvP 12, dungeons 3, raids 3, adventures 2. 03 Account-wide Points apply to all non-Hardcore characters. Window hotkey: Y. 04 Limit at launch You can spend no more than 16 points on a character. The excess goes to the rewards track. A campfire made with the Cooking profession becomes a shared camp: you can rest nearby, get buffs and place objects of your professions. 01 Campfire The campfire is single-use: it takes a few seconds to build, burns for about 10 minutes, with a 5 minute cooldown to place. 02 Slots A basic campfire is available without Cooking, with 3 objects. Cooking 140 gives 5 slots, 220 gives 10. 03 Shared camp Each character places one object, with a 1 hour cooldown per object. Together you make a shared camp. 04 Buffs To get the buffs, sit (/sit) nearby for at least 1 minute. They stack into one buff, “Camp Benefits”. Camp buffs are slightly weaker than class buffs and do not stack with them. 01 Class pace By forecasts, Hunter and Mage level fastest (about 8% faster than average), Warrior slowest (about 12%), Druid and Priest slightly slower than average. These are beta estimates, the figures may change. 02 No level scaling Dungeons are for their own levels, and you cannot run them by “pulling up” a weaker friend. 03 Save up rest The bedroll, Well Rested and food with an experience bonus stack. 04 Camp while leveling You can set up camp right while leveling; five minutes for a campfire pays off with buffs for the group. Tip From 4 November to 9 December, level up together through dungeons, and decide in advance who plays which class so you do not duplicate.

How Forever differs from Classic Era

Topic What Forever has General Eastern Kingdoms and Kalimdor, leveling to 60. A permanent game, not a season. No flying mounts and no level scaling, as in Classic. Content New zones, quests, 9 new dungeons, 3 new raids, a new battleground, the new Skyborne race. Classes and races Class talents and abilities were updated, there are new race and class combinations, and races lost resistances and gained their own abilities. Systems Legacy, camp, optional transmog and a choice of visual style (Classic or modern), official gamepad support. Items Stats and items were changed, so old Classic loot lists are unreliable.
04.11.2026. Blizzard has not yet confirmed the exact launch time. Some sites name 15:00 Pacific, which is 23:00 UTC .
Yes, a subscription or game time. Forever is a permanent game next to Retail and Classic, not a season.
How much are the packs, and do I need one?

Heroic Pack $29.99, Epic Pack $59.99, Warcraft Forever Collection $79.99. A pack is only needed for the Skyborne race and early name reservation: the other eight races and all nine classes do not need to be bought.
When can I reserve a name?
From 27.10 to 03.11 if you own Heroic, Epic or Collection. Up to three characters per account, first come, first served. This is not early access to the game.
Why a surname, and can two people share a name?

There are no realms, so the full name must be unique across the whole region. Two players can share a first name if their surnames differ. You can hide the surname: Esc → Options → Nameplates → My Secondary Name.

The new Forever race, unlocked by any of the three packs. Playable for both factions, the faction is chosen at character creation. Both branches speak a common language and share the Zephras Isle starting zone.
What is the level cap, and where do we level?
Up to 60, in the Eastern Kingdoms and Kalimdor. No flying mounts and no level scaling, as in Classic.
Can we play together in different modes?
No: you can only group within one mode. Modes at launch: Normal, PvP and RP, Hardcore comes later. In PvP an account can have only one faction.
Which region, mode and faction should we pick to play with friends?

The same for everyone. Regions are separate and there is no cross-region play, so pick the region with the best ping for most of you. Groups form only within one mode, and Alliance and Horde cannot group in any mode. In PvP an account has only one faction, so agree on it before name reservation opens on 27.10.
Where do I find a group?
On the Gabella Team Discord server. Groups for the 04.11 launch form there, and players agree on region, mode and faction. Gabella Team Discord ↗
09.12: Barrow Deeps (10 players), Hyjal Summit (20), Onyxia’s Lair (40). Until then you have five weeks for leveling and dungeons.
Can I still get into the beta?
No. Access was for Epic and Collection owners. The beta ended on 23.10 at 10:00 Pacific time.
Are old Classic guides still useful?
Only partly. Stats and items were changed, so old loot lists are unreliable. There are 9 new dungeons, 3 new raids, new zones and quests, and class talents were updated.
Is there modern graphics and gamepad support?
Yes: you can pick a visual style (Classic or modern), there is optional transmog and official gamepad support.

Guide / Privacy Privacy What data the site collects and what is stored in your browser. In short: without signing in we know nothing about you; after signing in we keep only your profile. Updated 23.10.2026
The guide works without signing in: then the site sets no cookies and does not know who you are. Signing in is only needed for a profile and the Roster. The site has no ads or comments.

You can sign in with Discord, Google, Battle.net, Telegram or by email. We never receive your password and do not keep these services’ access keys. From each way we take the minimum: Discord: ID and nickname. For members of the Gabella Team server, also the date they joined: it gives the team mark and the achievements for time on the server. Google: account number and first name. We do not ask for your email. Battle.net: account number and BattleTag. Telegram: ID and first name. Email: only a hash of the address, a one-way fingerprint. We do not keep the address itself: the sign-in link is sent by the Resend service. One account can have several ways to sign in: link and unlink them in your profile, under Account. Ways are never merged on their own: signing in a new way without linking it creates a new account. We also keep what you entered yourself: your characters (name, race, class, role, level, professions, play time), the look of your profile, your motto, the Looking for group mark and who invited you, if you came by their link. For achievements the site keeps counters: which guide sections you opened, how long you listened to the radio, which days you visited. Counters run only after you sign in. In the Roster and on your page everyone can see your characters, achievements, frame, motto and nickname, unless you turned it off. After you sign in, the site sets one cookie: a session key for 30 days. It is used only to keep you signed in; the database stores a hash of the k

Profiles are stored with Cloudflare (Workers and the D1 database), which processes them on our behalf. Sign-in emails are sent by Resend (servers in Ireland), also on our behalf. We keep profiles until you delete them. We do not share or sell them. An administrator can hide a character or motto that breaks the rules and close sign-in for an account that spams or insults people.

In My profile, under Account, you can download everything we keep about you as one file and delete your profile. Your characters, achievements, counters, feed entries and sessions are deleted with it at once. A deleted profile cannot be restored.

To see which pages people read, the site uses Cloudflare Web Analytics. It works without cookies, does not fingerprint your browser and does not track you across other sites. We only see totals: how many times a page was opened, from which country, on what kind of device and from which site. Individual visitors cannot be told apart. Cloudflare privacy policy

The site is hosted on GitHub Pages. Like any web server, GitHub receives your device’s IP address to deliver the page and may keep it in logs to protect against attacks. We have no access to those logs. GitHub privacy statement

In browser storage (localStorage) the site remembers your chosen theme, your hero (race, class, level and professions) if you entered them, and the radio settings: station, track, the queue of tracks, volume, sleep timer and ambient sounds, and on the In game page your timers and faction. To open the guide offline, the browser keeps copies of the pages. After you sign in, it also keeps a signed-in mark, a copy of your profile for faster loading and the achievement sound switch. This data stays on your device and is not sent anywhere. You can delete it by clearing the site data in your browser settings.

Fonts and images load from this site, with no third-party services. Radio music is stored in Cloudflare R2 and loads from our address media.gabella.site, only when you turn the radio on; as with the pages, Cloudflare receives your device’s IP address. The campfire, rain and wind sounds are made by the browser itself. Links to sources lead to other sites, which have their own privacy rules. Radio music: Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) and other authors from opengameart.org, licensed under Creative Commons BY 4.0 , Creative Commons BY 3.0 , Creative Commons CC0 .
